note: Cutaneous findings like livedo reticularis occur only in a minority of biallelic NOTCH3 cases and are explicitly described as non-obligatory for diagnosis.

evidence.text: The authors state that livedo reticularis can be observed in patients with biallelic loss-of-function NOTCH3 variants but is not an obligatory finding.

source.title: Early-onset vascular leukoencephalopathy caused by bi-allelic NOTCH3 variants
source.quote: Livedo reticularis, indicative of Sneddon syndrome, may occur, but is not obligatory.

evidence.text: Across a comprehensive series of biallelic NOTCH3 cases, livedo reticularis was documented in only four cases, demonstrating low overall sensitivity.

source.title: Clinical and neuroradiological spectrum of biallelic variants in NOTCH3
